creative_brief.emotional_promise: One touch wakes a tiny transformation: a perched bird becomes a shooting-star streak, then gravity returns the gate to quiet.
creative_brief.format_rationale: A one-piece desk toy needs immediate setup and recovery guidance, so two compact half-letter pages are complete without becoming report-like or overlong.
creative_brief.physical_format: Two-page US half-letter owner card, 5.5 × 8.5 inches, portrait
teaching_arc: Recognize the bird-to-star promise and exact included piece
Set the rocker upright on a clear level desk
Tap one upper shoulder sideways and release
Recognize the upright perched-bird ready pose
Correct over-motion, under-motion, or a tilted stop
Clean, inspect, store, and use the rocker safely
creative_brief.visual_motif: The exact arched product render anchors the cover; orbit-like arrows, star marks, rounded action cards, and the curved ready-pose panel echo its rocker and celestial transformation.

findings: Page 1 hero image overlapped and obscured the title and almost all subtitle in both color and grayscale.
The first-use view lacked a clear sideways tap direction and shoulder callout.
Small ochre accents were too pale in grayscale, weakening hierarchy.
resolved_changes: Reduced and moved the hero below a guaranteed clear title/subtitle area.
Added a high-contrast TAP SIDEWAYS arrow pointing toward the upper shoulder.
Darkened small accent text for grayscale and replaced the ambiguous star-level ready cue with upright perched-bird guidance.
